items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: He said, well, I left my boy with Gus, who's going to take?

ctx.x: So in the evening comes her. You have a good memory. She, let me tell you, I'm not even finished talking. So she come in the back, we had a dinner, we dressed. She said, oh he's a nice boy. She said, he's a nice boy. She said, I told him, you could go, but when I get sick, you come home. Boy told him, yeah, if you get sick I come home. Alright, we dressed, we come over. He said, well, I left my boy with Gus, who's going to take? He said, well, I say, Dipper, Johnny Dots. I see Joe Oliver, he had a preference of…
Well, Joe wasn't anxious to work then from the moment he wanted to be a gambler, you know. He ran 25 or so.
